1361.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1361.1001.1.description:
Check dut virtual mac is learnt on CPU port

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that the device's virtual (system) MAC is learnt and present on the CPU port via the system MAC table. Reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup, with no recent PASS.

1361.1001.2.description:
Send ethernet frames with unique src mac across multiple ports and verify they get learnt by dut

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies basic dynamic MAC learning across multiple ports. Injects Ethernet frames with distinct source MAC addresses from several test-box ports into the DUT and confirms every source MAC is dynamically learnt in the switch's MAC address table against the correct ingress port.

1361.1001.3.description:
Configure mac ageing-time and confirm dynamically learnt mac addresses are cleared after set time

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies dynamic MAC ageing. Configures a short MAC ageing-time, floods unique source MACs across multiple ports so they are learnt, then waits past the ageing interval and confirms all dynamically learnt entries are aged out and cleared from the table within the expected window.

1361.1001.4.description:
Create a static mac address entry and confirm pkt sent with the dst mac is only sent to the configured port

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies static MAC forwarding. Configures a static MAC address entry pointing at a specific port, sends a frame destined to that MAC, and confirms the frame is forwarded only out the configured port and not flooded to the other ports in the VLAN.

1361.1001.5.description:
Create a dynamic mac address entry for 3 ports and confirm pkts sent with the dst mac is only sent to the port on which the mac address was learnt

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies dynamic-MAC unicast forwarding. Learns a dynamic MAC on each of several ports, then sends frames destined to each learnt MAC and confirms each frame egresses only the port on which that MAC was learnt and is not seen on other VLAN ports.

1361.1001.6.description:
Enable thrash-limiting on 2 ports and send ethernet frames with src mac to both the ports alternatively. Check trash-limiting detection is triggered

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies MAC thrash-limiting detection. Enables thrash-limiting on two ports and sends frames with the same source MAC alternately into both ports to force MAC flapping, then confirms the switch detects and reports the MAC thrashing condition.

1361.1001.7.description:
Configure mac ageing-time with no timeout and confirm dynamically learnt mac addresses can be explicitly cleared by command

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies explicit clearing of dynamic MACs when ageing is effectively disabled. Configures the MAC ageing-time so entries do not time out, learns unique source MACs across ports, then issues the clear MAC address-table dynamic command and confirms all dynamically learnt entries are removed.

1361.1001.8.description:
Confirm dynamic mac addresses cleared by clear-mac-address-dynamic can be relearned

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies dynamic MACs can be relearned after being explicitly cleared. Over repeated cycles, learns source MACs across ports, clears them with clear mac address-table dynamic, and confirms they are removed and then successfully relearned on the next cycle.

1361.1001.9.description:
Confirm after mac learning has been disabled and re-enabled, dynamic mac addresses can be re-learned

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies dynamic MAC relearning around MAC-learning toggling. Learns and clears MACs, disables MAC learning and confirms no MACs are learnt while disabled, then re-enables learning and confirms MACs are learnt again, repeating across cycles.
